applies_to: AAON R-454B units for indoor agriculture (grow rooms) controlled by the VCCX-454-GH controller.
summary: The VCCX-454-GH is a version of the VCCX-454 unit controller for indoor agriculture, with grow, dry, fan, cool, heat and purge modes. Its on-board port connects to a BACnet MS/TP network. The object map is much smaller than the standard VCCX-454: about 50 read-only analog inputs, 7 writable analog values, about 100 read-only binary inputs and two multistate input/value pairs for operating mode and HVAC mode.
notes: AI, BI and MI objects are read-only; AV objects are read/write and only AV 3 and AV 4 are sensor values the BAS may write. MV access is not stated; it is shown as writable here because the values mirror the MI points as commands.
Instances are grouped per refrigeration circuit A-D (analog inputs in blocks from 50, 60, 70 and 80; binary inputs from 70, 90, 110 and 130), so numbering has gaps.
Points for refrigeration modules, MHGRV reheat, MODGAS and the 12-relay expansion board only report when fitted.
Source: Appendix C VCCX-454-GH BACnet, guide pages 79-86.

integration.summary: Wire the on-board port to the MS/TP trunk and set address, device ID and baud on the LCD. The BAS writes the space temperature and RH setpoints, can supply space temperature and RH through AV 3 and AV 4 (with AV 7 toggled as a keep-alive), and selects operating and HVAC mode through MV 1 and MV 2.

minimum_points.name: HVAC Mode
minimum_points.why: HVAC mode: grow, dry, fan, cool, heat, purge

minimum_points.name: Mode of Operation
minimum_points.why: Current operating state: off or operating

integration.enable: MV 1 Operating Mode (1 = off, 2 = operating) and MV 2 HVAC Mode (grow, dry, fan, cool, heat, purge) are the BACnet mode commands; MI 1 and MI 2 report the active values.
integration.heartbeat: When the controller uses BACnet space temperature and RH (AV 3, AV 4), the BAS must keep toggling AV 7 BACnet Alive Toggle. If it does not change for two minutes the controller falls back to its own sensors (if configured) or raises a space sensor failure alarm.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 3 Reference Space Temperature and AV 4 Reference Space RH are used when the controller is configured for BACnet space values; keep AV 7 toggling.
setup: MAC address, device ID (up to seven digits) and baud rate are set on the controller's LCD BACnet screens.
Supported MS/TP baud rates are 9.6K, 19.2K, 38.4K, 57.6K and 76.8K (from the PICS).
gotchas: Stop toggling AV 7 and the controller drops the BAS space values after two minutes.
